title: Separate deterministic analyzer rules from BCQuality
summary: Deterministic analyzer rules and their documentation are removed from BCQuality, leaving only knowledge that adds BC-specific context beyond what the compiler already enforces.
key_points: 18 deterministic rules and their samples are retired, including CodeCop formatting and style rules, AS0062, AS0011, AS0007 and compiler-enforced subscriber parameter matching
The Style, AppSource and Breaking Changes review skills no longer contain detection or example logic for these rules
The admission test now excludes compiler and analyzer duplicates for both review and authoring
Analyzer-related knowledge stays only when it adds exceptions, version boundaries, cross-object implications or remediation constraints
Deterministic tooling handles mechanical facts, while BCQuality focuses on BC-specific reasoning
quote: deterministic tooling establishes mechanical facts; BCQuality and the LLM focus on BC-specific context and reasoning
